meta.name: aggregation-method
meta.description: Aggregate multiple ranking ballots into a consensus ranking using a specified social choice method.

copy.tagline: 将多个排名选票合并为共识排名
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从多个人的排名中得出一个综合结果。
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate multiple ranking ballots into a consensus ranking
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to combine multiple rankings into one consensus.

howto.what: 安装后，你可以给Claude一组排名投票（ballots）和一种投票方法（method），它会计算出一个共识排名。支持Schulze、Borda、Kemeny-Young、Copeland和Condorcet等方法。
howto.when: 当你提供投票数据数组和指定的投票方法（如"Borda"）时触发。仅当输入包含这两项时才会执行。

say.text: 请用Borda方法聚合这些排名投票。
say.note: Claude将使用Borda计数计算共识排名。

say.text: 应用Condorcet方法产生共识排名。
say.note: Claude会检查Condorcet获胜者并输出完整排名。

say.text: 使用Schulze方法计算最终排名。
say.note: Claude执行Schulze方法得到排序结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can provide Claude with an array of ranking ballots and a specified method; it will compute a consensus ranking. Supports Schulze, Borda, Kemeny-Young, Copeland, and Condorcet methods.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you supply a ballots array and a method string (e.g., "Borda"). Only executes when both inputs are present.

say_en.text: Aggregate these rankings using the Borda method.
say_en.note: Claude computes consensus via Borda count.

say_en.text: Apply Condorcet method to produce consensus ranking.
say_en.note: Claude checks for Condorcet winner and outputs full ranking.

say_en.text: Compute final ranking using Schulze method.
say_en.note: Claude executes Schulze algorithm to produce order.
